name: virtual-expo
description: Virtual Expo 2.5D Proof of Concept (FE + BE npm workspaces)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n BE,FE -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w BE" "npm run dev -w FE"
scripts.build: npm run build -w BE && npm run build -w FE
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w BE && npm run typecheck -w FE
